---
title: Bagna Cauda
id: MAR-0017
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 25
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 9 salted anchovies
- 3 garlic cloves
- 1 dl milk
- 3 dl extra virgin olive oil
## Method
1. Peel the garlic, soak it in the milk for 2 hours, then drain it and crush it in a mortar.
2. Desalt the anchovies under running water, bone them, dry them, and cut them into pieces.
3. Blend the anchovies and garlic in a terracotta dish and cook, stirring, for 10 minutes.
4. Serve the bagna cauda as soon as it is removed from the heat on the appropriate warmer, accompanied by raw vegetable sticks (Monferrato cardoon, peppers, spring onions...).
